IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Wallace, Hinkle, Condotta, O'Brien, Fromhold, Ahern, McCune and Warnick

Bill.BriefDescription: Providing a sales tax exemption for certain trail grooming services.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing a sales tax exemption for trailgrooming on private and stateowned land; and adding a new section tochapter 82.08 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to sales of trailgrooming services to the state of Washington or nonprofit corporationsorganized under chapter 24.03 RCW. For the purposes of this section,"trail grooming" means the activity of snow compacting, snowredistribution, or snow removal on stateowned or privatelyownedtrails.
